name: polaris-tests::cache_uses_real_redb_store_across_reopen_and_purge

test_list.description: A TieredCache backed by the production EventLog redb ExactCacheStore persists across owner reopen and purges only the selected scope.

inputs.name: workspace_key
inputs.description: A real cache key derived in a workspace scope.

inputs.name: event_log_path
inputs.description: A unique temporary redb database path.

output_description: The test verifies cache persistence, L2 hit promotion and isolated scope purge using the production redb adapter.
